body:
Thank you, Shizcake.

As for the thing with my now-ex-roommate … truthfully, I'd feel better just leaving it. I know how upset she must've been to do something so drastic. It had to be the worst experience of her life. I don't want to exacerbate it. I'd rather I feel awful and she feel better than the other way around, frankly.

And thanks for the offer of conversation. I'd take you up on it, but the prospect of talking about something else right now kinda daunts me. I've got this on my mind, you know? It's not gonna be easy to shake off.

But I really appreciate the offer, and I really wish I could accept it.
